meta.title: jss-devtools init: the decided flow (node preset)
meta.subtitle: Decided with the user on 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-27; see decision-log.md
meta.description: The syntax picks the mode. Every check runs before the first write; the install is the only step that can fail after files are written, and it rolls nothing back.

views.title: 1. Arguments pick the mode
views.narrative: init <dir> creates a project; init alone sets up the current folder. A flag used in the wrong mode (--pm or -f) or a framework other than node exits 1.

views.title: 2. Create: question and preflight
views.narrative: Only the package manager is asked (skipped with --pm; -y takes npm). Preflight: <dir> missing or empty, git on PATH, <pm> --version answers.

views.title: 3. Existing: preflight
views.narrative: package.json parses and is no monorepo; tsconfig.json exists; .git is here; core.hooksPath is free; the package manager is detected (stopDir) and installed; owned configs and their other names are absent, or -f.

views.title: 4. Plan, dry run, confirmation
views.narrative: The plan lists + new, ~ changed, - deleted. --dry-run stops there with exit 0. The confirmation is the last gate; declining exits 1 and nothing is written.

views.title: 5. Writes and install
views.narrative: Create runs git init -q -b main first, because prepare: husky needs .git. Files are written, shared files merged, -f deletions applied, then <pm> install. An install failure keeps everything and prints the install command.
